scripts.sync-spec: pnpm exec esbuild scripts/sync-spec.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=scripts/.sync-spec.mjs && node scripts/.sync-spec.mjs
scripts.build: pnpm run sync-spec && ng build honeycomb-ds-plugin && pnpm run build:plugin
scripts.init: pnpm run sync-spec && concurrently --kill-others --names plugin,serve "pnpm run watch" "pnpm run serve:assets"
